limits: One indoor RAW; no measured color target or same-scene Hasselblad reference.
Metadata exposure compensation is not calibrated middle-gray matching.
Comparison images are SDR diagnostic views of finalized 24MP HDR HEIFs, not HDR screen captures.

validation.apple_image_regression: passed including real 48MP RAW and 14 SDR/HDR exports

third_party_dcp.note: This study uses the RAW embedded profile. The optional DCP download workflow requires email/terms; no checkout or external message was submitted.

limits: One indoor ProRAW; source bridge range statistics use 2048-edge decoded input, not every full-source pixel.
Exposure probes sample channels between 0.001 and 0.4; they do not prove all-scene physical radiometric linearity.
EDR amount changes decoded pixel values even when boost/local tone are disabled.
No controlled color target or native Phocus reference render was used; no absolute color-accuracy or Hasselblad-match Delta E is claimed.
Outputs are 24MP after full 48MP processing. New candidate 48MP delivery, sustained capture, power and screen-brightness appearance remain outside this study.
